# Browser dependencies

- PDF.js 3.11.174 (Apache-2.0): PDF input and preview; see PDFJS-LICENSE.txt.
- JSZip 3.10.1 (MIT): ZIP downloads; see JSZIP-LICENSE.txt.
- pdf-lib 1.17.1 (MIT): raster PDF output; see PDF-LIB-LICENSE.md.

All dependencies are distributed locally. Document conversion runs in the browser without uploading document contents.
